title: Lead Prepayment Collected with the Mold Remediation Signing Deposit
content:
Lead is prepaid with the Mold Remediation signing deposit on the following terms. When the company Water Damage Mitigation job linked to the Mold Remediation job carries a lead-safe setup line and the growth is in a living area or basement, the tier's lead-safe setup fee is prepaid with the deposit; when the job has no linked water job, or its linked water job carries no lead-safe setup line, and the building was built before the RRP year-built cutoff of 1978, the lead dust-wipe fee of 135.00 is prepaid for the paint testing that decides whether lead-safe work is needed; every other job prepays nothing for lead.

## Condition table

| Linked water job carries a lead-safe setup line | Growth location | Built before 1978 | Prepaid with the deposit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Living area or basement | Any | The tier's lead-safe setup fee |
| Yes | Attic, crawlspace or HVAC | Any | Nothing |
| No, or no linked water job | Any | Yes | 135.00 lead dust-wipe fee |
| No, or no linked water job | Any | No | Nothing |

**Records read.** The charge lines of the Water Damage Mitigation job the mold job is linked to (whether any lead-safe setup line is booked there), the mold job's growth location and the building's year built on the mold job.

**Hypothetical cases.** A basement job behind a water job that booked lead-safe setup prepays the tier's lead-safe setup fee whatever the year built. A 1971 house whose attic job has no linked water job prepays 135.00. A 1984 house with no lead-safe setup on its linked water job prepays nothing.
